response.justification: While Bogdan brings 15+ years of software development experience and strong fundamentals, this role is fundamentally mismatched. Most critically, native-level Japanese language proficiency is a required qualification and is entirely absent from the resume. Beyond this blocker, his recent career has focused on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, AI infrastructure) rather than embedded systems, security, or networking. His C programming experience is dated (2014-2015), and there is no evidence of expertise in required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, attack detection), embedded firmware development, or Linux kernel source-code modification. While he demonstrates strong learning ability, the domain gap is too substantial.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (15+ years) across multiple domains with proven ability to learn complex technical systems
Some relevant background with C/C++ and Linux from National Instruments (2014-2015) and demonstrated low-level systems thinking through D language work
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, DevOps) and mentoring ability that could support collaborative development
concerns: Native-level Japanese language proficiency is a required qualification and is completely absent; no Japanese listed in language skills
Recent career trajectory focused on web/full-stack development; no demonstrated expertise in embedded networking, security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal), or firmware development
C programming experience is 11 years outdated; no evidence of Linux kernel source-code modification or embedded device security/tamper detection experience

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking or security domain expertise
Strong software fundamentals and documented learning ability
